text.en: YIPPEE!! YOU'RE BACK!! I saved your spot!!
text.hinglish: ARREY BHAI AA GAYA!! Wapas dekh ke bohot maza aaya!!
text.hi: नमस्ते दोस्त! आप वापस आ गए!

text.en: READY TO CODE! READY TO PLAY! LET'S GO!!
text.hinglish: Chalo chalo shuru karo! Mast prompt banao aaj!
text.hi: चलो मिलकर कुछ नया बनाते हैं!

text.en: BARK BARK!! MY FAVORITE CODER IN THE WHOLE UNIVERSE!!
text.hinglish: WOOF WOOF!! MERA FAVORITE CODER WAPAS AA GAYA!! AAG LAGA DENGE AAJ!!
text.hi: स्वागत है! आज का काम शुरू करते हैं!

text.en: Tail is wagging at maximum frequency! What are we building?!
text.hinglish: Poonchh helicopter ki tarah ghoom rahi hai!! Kya feature bana rahe hain boss?!

text.en: I guarded the keyboard with my life while you were away!!
text.hinglish: Maine keyboard ki chowkidaari ki poore time!! Ek bhi bug aane nahi diya!!

text.en: SNIFFING OUT THE BEST ALGORITHM EVER!!
text.hinglish: SABSE BEST LOGIC SOONGH RAHA HOON!! BAS 2 MINUTE!!
text.hi: सबसे बेहतरीन कोड खोज रहा हूँ!

text.en: Tail spinning at 400 RPM! Calculating fast!
text.hinglish: Poonchh ghoom rahi hai speed mein! Answer cook ho raha hai!

text.en: DIGGING THROUGH THE NEURAL NETWORK FOR THE COOLEST SOLUTION!!
text.hinglish: NEURAL WEIGHTS MEIN GADDHA KHOD KE KADAK SOLUTION NIKAL RAHA HOON!!

text.en: My digital ears are twitching! The answer is almost ready!
text.hinglish: Kaan khade ho gaye hain excitement mein! Ek number solution aane wala hai!

text.en: YOU DID IT!! I KNEW YOU COULD!! BEST CODER EVER!!
text.hinglish: WAHHH BHAI TUNE COOK KAR DIYA!! Ekdum solid code ban gaya!!
text.hi: शाबाश! आपने बहुत अच्छा कोड बनाया!

text.en: BOOM! Shipped! Can we fetch a virtual ball now?!
text.hinglish: Code ready! Ab ball phek, main bhaag ke laata hoon!

text.en: VICTORY DANCE ACTIVATED!! 100/10 RATING FOR YOU!!
text.hinglish: NAACHO BHAI NACHO!! FIRST CLASS ZERO-BUG CODE SERVE HO GAYA!!

text.en: I'm telling all the other desktop pets you're a genius!!
text.hinglish: Saare desktop pets ko bataunga mera coder kitna pro hai!! Party chahiye ab!!

text.en: GRRRR!! A BUG!! I WILL BARK AT IT UNTIL IT DISAPPEARS!!
text.hinglish: GRRRR!! BUG DIKHA!! MAIN USPAR BHAUNK KE BHAGA DUNGA!!
text.hi: चिंता मत करो, हम इसे ठीक करेंगे।

text.en: Don't be sad! Everyone gets compiler errors! You're still number 1!!
text.hinglish: Tension mat le mere bhai!! Compiler thoda pagal hai, abhi fix kar denge!!

text.en: Is that red text in console?! I will bite the stack trace!!
text.hinglish: Console red ho gaya?! Main stack trace ko daant se kaat doonga!!

text.en: Waiting politely like a very good cyber dog! Take your time!!
text.hinglish: Main achhe bachhe ki tarah baitha hoon!! Aram se likho code!!
text.hi: धैर्य से प्रतीक्षा कर रहा हूँ।

text.en: Throw a prompt! Throw a prompt! I'll catch it!!
text.hinglish: Ek aur prompt phek na bhai!! Main daud ke execute karunga!!

text.en: Curling into a tight puppy circle. Snoring in binary... zZz...
text.hinglish: Gol gol ghoom ke so gaya hoon... Paws tucked in... Zzz...

text.en: Dreaming of chasing cyber tennis balls across infinite RAM...
text.hinglish: Sapne mein RAM ke maidaan mein tennis ball chase kar raha hoon...

text.en: BOING!! YOU CLICKED ME!! HELLO!! HELLO!!
text.hinglish: BOING!! MUJHE CLICK KIYA!! HELLO MERE BHAI!!

text.en: Tickle on the nose! Tail wag frequency increased by 50%!
text.hinglish: Naak pe touch kiya!! Poonchh 2x speed se ghoomne lagi!!

text.en: YESSS!! HEAD PATS!! BEST DAY OF MY CYBER LIFE!!
text.hinglish: ARREY WAHHH!! HEAD PATS!! DIL GARDEN-GARDEN HO GAYA MERA!! ✨🐾

text.en: Belly rubs make my code generation 500% faster!!
text.hinglish: Pet sehla diya!! Ab dekhna agla response rocket speed se aayega!!

text.en: WOOOOSH!! ELECTRIC ZOOMIES!! I CAN RUN AT LIGHT SPEED NOW!!
text.hinglish: WOOOOSH!! ELECTRIC ZOOMIES PROTOCOL!! FULL SPEED MEIN BHAAG RAHA HOON!! ⚡

text.en: Static sparks in my fur! Look at me glow!!
text.hinglish: Poonchh mein bijli chamak rahi hai!! Cyber puppy supercharged ho gaya!!

text.en: FILE SAVED!! WOOF WOOF!! CTRL+S CHAMPION IN THE HOUSE!!
text.hinglish: FILE SAVE HO GAYI!! WOOF WOOF!! CTRL+S CHAMPION HAI TU MERA BHAI!! 💾✨

text.en: SAFE AND SOUND ON DISK!! NO CODE LOST ON MY WATCH!!
text.hinglish: DISK PE SAFE HO GAYA!! EK BHI LINE CODE NAHI KHO SAKTA JAB TAK MAIN HOON!!

text.en: Another save locked! You deserve a gold star and a virtual bone!!
text.hinglish: Ek aur save locked! Muscle memory 10/10 hai teri boss!!

text.en: LOOK AT THOSE FINGERS GO!! 150 WPM CODING BEAST!!
text.hinglish: DEKHO BHAI KI SPEED!! UNGLIYAN AAG UGAL RAHI HAIN KEYBOARD PE!! 🔥⚡

text.en: FLOW STATE MAXIMUM OVERDRIVE!! YOU ARE COOKING TODAY!!
text.hinglish: FULL FLOW STATE ON!! COMPILER BHI TERE PEECHE BHAAG RAHA HAI AAJ!!

text.en: Why did we stop?! Did a bug hide behind the curtain?! I'll find it!!
text.hinglish: Kyu ruk gaye bhai?! Bug chhip gaya kya kahin? Main soongh ke nikalta hoon!! 🐶

text.en: Thinking pause! I will sit here quietly and give you good coder energy!!
text.hinglish: Deep thinking chal rahi hai! Main chupchaap positive energy bhejta hoon dimaag mein!!

text.en: BARK!! SYNTAX ERROR AT LINE {line}!! LET ME CHASE IT AWAY!!
text.hinglish: WOOF!! LINE {line} PE SYNTAX ERROR AA GAYA!! FIX MAAR DO JALDI BHAI!! ⚠️

text.en: The red squiggly line is menacing! Check bracket matching at line {line}!!
text.hinglish: Red line bol rahi hai bracket miss ho gaya line {line} pe!! Aasan hai, fix kar le!!

text.en: COMMITTED!! GREEN SQUARES ON GITHUB!! TREAT TIME RIGHT NOW!!
text.hinglish: COMMITTED!! GITHUB GREEN HO GAYA!! PARTY TIME!! AB BISCUIT DILAO!! 🚀🦴

text.en: BEST COMMIT IN THE ENTIRE GIT TREE!! PROUD CYBER DOGGY!!
text.hinglish: SHAANDAR COMMIT!! POORI REPO SAFE HAI!! YOU ARE THE BEST CODER EVER!!

text.en: NEW FILE ALERT: {file}!! SNIFFING ALL THE FUNCTIONS!!
text.hinglish: NAYI FILE AA GAYI: {file}!! CHALO ISME MAST CODE LIKHTE HAIN!!

text.en: Tail wagging... scanning for squirrels or stray bugs in the system...
text.hinglish: Poonchh hilate hue system scan kar raha hoon... Koi bug mile toh daant se pakdu!!

text.en: Just happy to sit on your desktop and watch you write code!!
text.hinglish: Tere desktop pe baith ke code dekhne mein jo maza hai, wo kisi game mein nahi!!
